name: instance-cluster-cap
summary: Zone.exe keeps at most 10 instance-dungeon clusters per process (ClusterManager::Clusters[10]). Move the array out of the object and raise the bounds.
status: BUILT AND STATICALLY VERIFIED 2026-09-14; see NOTES-map-caps.md for the live run.

target.note: Chained builds need --allow-hash-mismatch; no other recipe touches these sites.

clusters.why: Both search-loop bounds are `cmp eax, imm8` and the List<MapCluster> capacity is `push imm8`; sign-extended imm8 tops out at 127, and the capacity is clusters + 4 (the 2016 headroom over 10: 14 nodes for 10 slots).

why: MapClusterManager::ClusterManager (?mapclustermanager@@3V..., static at 0xD742B30, 0x28098 bytes) holds
MapCluster* Clusters[10] at +0x28068 in the MIDDLE of the object (a Metronome follows at +0x28090).
AddInstanceDungeonCluster (0x484850) scans it for a null slot and returns false past 10 -> the caller
asserts 'Cannot Add[10]' at startup when Field.txt puts more than 10 InstanceDungeon rows on the zone.
Users of the array (tools/xref_range.py --disp 0x28068-0x28098 and --range 0xD742B30-0xD76ABC8):
ctor 0x4A0F00           ten unrolled `mov [esi+0x28068..0x2808C], edi` (zeroing)
AddInstanceDungeonCluster  lea ecx,[esi+0x28068] ; ... cmp eax, 0xa
cm_AddTutorialMapCluster   lea ecx,[edi+0x28068] ; ... cmp eax, 0xa
~ClusterManager            lea ebx,[esi+0x28068] ; mov [ebp-0x10], 0xa  (trip count)
Nothing addresses a slot absolutely (0xD76AB98..0xD76ABC0 has no reference).
Growing the array in place would shift the Metronome and every reference to it; relocating the whole
object would mean rewriting ~45 `mov ecx, 0xD742B30` immediates. Instead the array alone moves: each
`lea reg, [this + 0x28068]` (6 bytes: 8D /r disp32) becomes `mov reg, imm32` (B8+r imm32, 5 bytes)
followed by a nop - three edits per site: the opcode byte, the 32-bit address, the padding byte. The
ctor's ten stores keep zeroing the now-unused in-object array, which is harmless; the new array starts
zero because the section does. This is the only recipe that rewrites instruction bytes rather than
operands, which is why the opcodes are named constants and every one is expected before it is written.
A new cluster's slot index is also its node index in the List<MapCluster> base
(AddInstanceDungeonCluster+0x9C..0xC5 indexes [this+8] by the slot), whose capacity the ctor sets
with `push 0xe` - raised to clusters + 4 to keep the 2016 headroom.
